boundaryVintage: Municipal snapshot; 2022 boundary transfers neutralized by comparison-area unions
boundaryNote: City of Victoria only. Eight individual neighbourhoods plus Downtown/Fairfield and Oaklands/Jubilee combined areas. Harris Green is included in Downtown; North and South Jubilee are together. Current municipal geometry is used: the unions address the documented June 2022 transfers, but this is not an archived 2021 vertex file and historical vertex identity has not been independently verified.
coverageNote: Ten comparison areas cover the City's twelve current neighbourhoods. This is not Greater Victoria. 2021 census measures are historical; parks, facilities and bus stops use separately dated snapshots. Combined-area median shelter costs remain missing.

population.label: Population
population.note: 2021 total population from the city's special census tabulation; rounded counts summed for combined areas.
population.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

households.label: Private households
households.note: 2021 private households; rounded counts summed for combined areas.
households.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

children.label: Children under 15
children.note: People aged 0–14 divided by total population; calculated from 100% census counts.
children.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

householdSize.label: Average household size
householdSize.note: People in private households divided by private households. Calculated from counts because the city's published averages are rounded to whole persons.
householdSize.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

livingAlone.label: One-person households
livingAlone.note: One-person households divided by all private households; 100% census counts.
livingAlone.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

apartments.label: Homes in apartment buildings
apartments.note: Occupied dwellings in buildings with fewer than five or five-plus storeys divided by all occupied dwellings; duplexes excluded.
apartments.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

renters.label: Households renting
renters.note: Renter households divided by private households by tenure; 25% census sample, rounded counts.
renters.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

tenantShelter.label: Median tenant shelter cost
tenantShelter.note: 2021 monthly costs of occupied rentals, including utilities where applicable; all sizes, 25% sample. Not current asking rents. Combined-area medians are unavailable.
tenantShelter.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

transit.label: Commutes by public transit
transit.note: Employed people 15+ with a usual workplace or no fixed workplace; excludes working at home. 25% sample; May 2021 pandemic conditions.
transit.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

walkCycle.label: Commutes on foot or by bike
walkCycle.note: Walking plus cycling among the same commuting population; excludes working at home. 25% sample; pandemic-era travel.
walkCycle.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

parkland.label: Mapped park and open-space area
parkland.note: Union of included park/open-space polygons intersecting the area, divided by total polygon area; overlaps counted once. Schools and cemeteries excluded.
parkland.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

parks.label: Parks and open-space sites
parks.note: Distinct published park names with more than 1 m² inside the boundary; multipart records with the same name are combined. A site spanning areas can appear in both.
parks.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

busStops.label: Bus stops in or near the area
busStops.note: Distinct stop IDs inside or within 800 m of the polygon. Straight-line distance to the area, not a walking distance from a home or service frequency.
busStops.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

communityCentres.label: Mapped community centres
communityCentres.note: City inventory points classified Community Centre inside the area; boundary points may appear in both adjacent areas. Other mapped civic facilities appear in the amenities list.
communityCentres.geographicScope: City of Victoria only: eight neighbourhoods and two explicitly combined comparison areas; excludes other Greater Victoria municipalities.

sections.heading: People and households
sections.text: The 2021 census counted 6,875 people in this comparison area. The share of residents under 15 was 6.9%; the share of one-person households was 51.9%. The calculated average was 1.73 people per household.

sections.heading: Housing
sections.text: In 2021, this area had 3,255 private households. The share of occupied homes in apartment buildings, excluding duplexes, was 78.2%; the share of households renting was 65.9%. Median tenant shelter cost was $1,190 a month for occupied rentals, not today's asking rent.

sections.heading: Parks and everyday facilities
sections.text: The municipal inventory maps 17 park and open-space sites overlapping the area, covering 3.0% of its polygon. Examples include Balfour Playlot, Bay and Government Parkette, Blanshard Parkway, Cecelia Cove Park. Mapped civic facilities inside the area include Burnside Gorge Community Centre.

sections.heading: Getting around and interpreting the area
sections.text: In the 2021 commuting sample, the public-transit share was 14.7% and the walking/cycling share was 23.0%; people working at home are excluded. The current GTFS snapshot lists 185 bus-stop IDs inside or within 800 m of the boundary, which does not measure frequency or walking access from a particular home. This is a City of Victoria neighbourhood; the profile does not cover similarly named areas elsewhere in Greater Victoria.
